notHeld.D100399X012: The Fisher EW/EWT instruction manual. Cited in the Process Core until 2026-10-11 as the source of the valve body archetype (Figure 24) and of the standard packing torque window (Table 6), in eighty-nine places. The vault has never held it and there is no sign it was ever read here. Both claims are re-sourced to documents we DO hold: the shape matches Figure 11-5 of the Control Valve Sourcebook -- Oil & Gas (drawing W6022-2), and every torque value matches Table 4 of D100390X012 to the lbf.in. No number changed. The document number now survives only in comments recording the correction, which is why it is listed here rather than removed.
notHeld.D100017X012: Cited until 2026-10-11 for "Table 12", the ED stem diameter and yoke boss, in thirty-four places -- the three mounting numbers the assembly layer exists to refuse a bad pairing on. Never held. Re-sourced to D100390X012, which we hold: Table 11 maps valve size to stem diameter and the packing repair-kit tables pair each stem with its yoke boss. Every value in the catalogue was already correct against it.
